message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large, red, bold lettering at the top. The background is a blue gradient.

Two caricatured men are featured. On the left, a man in a white short-sleeved shirt and dark pants walks across a thin, metallic grey pole that is angled upwards. He grips the pole with both hands, leaning forward with a focused expression. To the right, a larger man in a dark suit, white shirt, and red tie stands facing forward with a smiling expression, eyes closed behind glasses. His hands are open and gesturing outward.

Floating around the men are several three-dimensional "candlestick" chart icons in green and red, alongside a jagged blue line graph that stretches across the upper right.

White text on the left reads: "BEREBUT KENDALI PASAR MODAL." Below this, smaller text reads: "Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin dan Sufmi Dasco Ahmad mendapat arena baru berebut pengaruh di depan Presiden Prabowo. Saling telikung mengendalikan otoritas bursa dan pengawas keuangan. H.56." Additional text at the very top includes: "Suka-suka Memilih Hakim Konstitusi H.26" and "Antisipasi Bias Akal Imitasi H.80." A barcode and issue information are in the top right corner.
